nodes.title: B. Definitions
nodes.summary: The CyberShield policy provides coverage for Cyber Bullying or Defamation Event, Extortion Loss, Data Recovery, and Media Liability. It requires reporting of incidents to police and insurer within specified timeframes. Reimbursement is subject to conditions and exclusions. The policy also defines terms and excludes claims arising out of certain events.

nodes.title: C. Exclusions
nodes.summary: The CyberShield policy provides coverage for various types of cyber-related risks, including theft of funds, unauthorized access, phishing, and terrorism. It excludes coverage for dishonest or improper conduct, bodily injury, property damage, and intellectual property and trade secrets. The policy also outlines the definitions of key terms, such as Personal Information, Mobile Wallet, and Non-Fiat Currency. It requires policyholders to report claims promptly and provides conditions for payment, including the limit of liability and sanctions.

nodes.title: D. General Conditions
nodes.summary: The CyberShield policy covers various types of losses and claims, including non-fiat currency losses, outage/disturbance losses, illegal use of data, unauthorized collection of data, expenses prior to notification of claim, insolvency, immoral/obscene services, and more. It also outlines the conditions for reporting claims, other insurance, claims, and fraudulent claims, as well as the limit of liability and sanctions.
